Data 57 (2012) 339 (data public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive; validation/data/ethanol_water_101kPa.json). AAD 0.09 K in T, 0.0033 in y (max 0.26 K, 0.0084). Data consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.003 (passes, < 0.01).

Fitted to 24 T-x-y points at 101.3 kPa from Calvar, Dominguez, Tojo, Fluid Phase Equilib. 235 (2005) 215 (data public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive; validation/data/ethyl-acetate_ethanol_101kPa.json); checked against Zhang et al., Fluid Phase Equilib. 454 (2017) 91. Data consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.005 (passes, < 0.01).

Fitted to 22 T-x-y points at 101.325 kPa (Zhu et al., J. Chem. Eng. Data 58 (2013) 7) and 37 total pressures at 298.15 and 323.15 K, static method, with the measured pure-component pressures (Brandt, Horstmann, Steinigeweg, Gmehling, Fluid Phase Equilib. 376 (2014) 48), both data public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (validation/data/ethanol_acetic-acid_101kPa.json, ethanol_acetic-acid_px_brandt2014.json); a fit to either set alone misses the other by about 3 K or 9 %. Temperature range of the data: 273.35-343.55 K; outside it the parameters are extrapolated.
